title: Part Five: Public Safety and Guns

sections.brief: Homicide over time: US 10.2 (1980), 4.4 (2014), 6.6 (2020), 6.8 (2021), 4.1 (2025, record low; 2026 still falling); gun share 59-77%; Black/white ~8:1; Israel police counts 2009/2018, Taub crude rates 1.56 (2019) to 3.04 (2023), Arab 4.90 to 11.11 vs Jewish 0.67 to 0.85, ratio 4:1 to 13:1; Arab 73% of victims 2018-Oct 2023; no long Israeli series found. Figures: stats

The Arab-community killings: police counts 2018-2023 and Abraham Initiatives counts (126/244/230/252; 184 by 13 Oct 2026 vs 200); ~12 per 100k in 2025 (book's arithmetic); police dispute; clearance 10-21% vs ~65% for Jewish victims; 2021 plans, Ben-Gvir's ministry, cuts, Dec 2025 redirect, July 2026 Shin Bet role (NIS 497m) and rights groups' objections; framed as a failure of policing and services. Figures: time; compare

Gun law: Second Amendment, Heller, Bruen, BSCA 2022, Trump EO Feb 2025 vs Israel's Firearms Law 1949 (discretionary licence, thresholds); guns per 100 (2017 snapshot: 120.5 vs 6.7); Israeli licensed guns 1998-2018; the October 2023 loosening (250,000 applications in 50 days, ~188,000 licences in a year, temporary staff, Lahav 433 probe, US rifle hold); US gun deaths 2024 (44,447; 62% suicide) with peaks; mass shootings by definition (GVA, FBI active shooter) vs Israel's terror attacks (Ramot Junction 2025). Figures: compare; stats
